item.description:
TOMORA - 2026-07-25 live Fuji Rock Festival (1080p VFR 192Kbps AAC LC 16x9 twitch stream capture)

TOMORA
Fuji Rock Festival 2026
Naeba Ski Resort
Yuzawa
Japan
July 25, 2026

TOMORA is Tom Rowlands (The Chemical Brothers), Aurora Aksnes (AURORA), and Amalie Holt Kleive (AURORA)

Despite the lower bitrate, this is far better for remastering via AI than the other version shared (which is a 10.5Mbps screen recording with unfixable macroblocking, judder, and glitches). This gig should respond well to the new video supersampling remastering process called HAFVSP.

About the logo: I'm not sure why twitch didn't use their logo (or none).

I know the capturer's prior work and verified the process used. This was the only gig from Fuji Rock he/she captured. Unless one of the other 6 billion folks who could have captured the festival shares their captures, the rest is lost media.

VFR was confirmed with ffmpeg -vf vfrdet. If pushed, Gemini Flash Extended AI has an algorithm to create temporally correct 29.97FPS CFR interpolation using Topaz Video AI Chronos via the CLI. You must use real Chronos CFR video not fake CFR (that ffmpeg can do) for use with most remastering processes. Topaz will need real CFR to produce judder free output.

TOMORA uses a lot of pink lighting. Videocameras can't focus on pink due to a physics issue called longitudinal chromatic aberration. Red and blue are at opposite ends of the visible spectrum and lenses put the focused light in different planes.

I hope to remaster this at the original 1920x1080p resolution at 59.94fps, and other TOMORA videos with HAFVSP which may reduce or eliminate the pink blur. Sharemania has a upscales forum. Post your best effort (use your process or HAFVSP). Be sure to include your source file (or link/description), detailed process, and lineage.
